What's new in EnigmaCast

A new Radio section in the menu, with thousands of internet radio stations. You can search, filter by country or genre, save favourites, see recently played stations, and view now-playing information. The full-screen player has a sleep timer and screen-burn protection, and it follows your chosen theme.

A backup TV guide automatically fills in programme information for channels that have none of their own, on satellite and IPTV. Countries are detected automatically, including Germany, Austria and Switzerland, and you can add extra countries in Settings.

Channels without guide information can now be selected and watched from the TV guide. The guide shows saved programme information straight away. Settings pages use smaller, cleaner text, and remote control navigation has been improved.
